facts.fact: Minister Angellah Kairuki told the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference that government-funded construction of 758 new towers and upgrade of over 300 had connected more than 1,301 villages and an estimated 8.5 million people.

TZA.note: Digital skills development is only named as an ITU priority; no programme stated.

facts.fact: Minister Angellah Kairuki said the National ICT Broadband Backbone connects all 31 regions of Tanzania.
facts.system: National Information and Communications Technology Broadband Backbone (NICTBB)

facts.fact: Minister Angellah Kairuki said the national backbone is linked to international submarine cables and to neighbouring countries, without naming cables or counting routes.
